_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in Ghanaian cedis. The debt component, history and facts are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_ghana.py from the Ministry of Finance's quarterly Public Debt Statistical Bulletin (needs pypdf); edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Ghana
title: Ghana Debt Clock: Live Central Government Public Debt, Official Data
headline: central government debt
headline_long: central government public debt (including government-guaranteed debt)
subject: The Government of Ghana
sum_note: Ghana's provisional nominal central government debt, including government-guaranteed debt, quarter-end, from the Ministry of Finance's Public Debt Statistical Bulletin.
scope_note: This is the "provisional nominal central government debt (including government-guaranteed debt)" that the Ministry of Finance states in its quarterly Public Debt Statistical Bulletin, Table 1: external plus domestic debt, in cedis. It includes debt the government has guaranteed, which many countries report separately, so it is wider than a plain central government borrowing figure. Local governments are not in it. The Ministry labels the latest quarter provisional and may revise it in the next bulletin; this page re-bases to each new bulletin.
trend_why: We use the change over the latest twelve months rather than the last quarter because quarterly changes swing with the exchange rate and with issuance.
legend: Ghana's public debt is reported quarterly, at quarter-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official figures, shown here next to them.
cadence: Quarterly. The Ministry of Finance publishes each quarter's bulletin about two to three months after the quarter ends.
after_text: , about two to three months after each quarter-end
next_update: The Ministry of Finance publishes each quarter's Public Debt Statistical Bulletin about two to three months after the quarter ends; this page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

population.source_name: Ghana Statistical Service, 2021 Population and Housing Census, total population
population.method_short: GSS 2021 census count, the latest official count

components.label: Ghana central government public debt
components.source_name: Ministry of Finance of Ghana, Public Debt Statistical Bulletin, Table 1 Public Debt Dynamics, GH₵ billion
components.source_locator: Quarterly PDF Public Debt Statistical Bulletin, Table 1, total public debt (external + domestic)
components.includes: Central government debt in cedis, domestic and external, including government-guaranteed debt. Excludes local governments and the borrowing of state-owned enterprises that the government has not guaranteed.

notes: Why the Ministry's bulletin: it is the Ministry of Finance's own quarterly statement of the debt, with domestic and external parts. The fetcher reads Table 1 and checks that external plus domestic equals the total.
Includes guarantees: the Ministry's headline measure counts government-guaranteed debt, so the figure is not like-for-like with pages that count only direct borrowing.
Provisional: the latest quarter is provisional and may be revised.

Currency: Ghanaian cedis. The World Debt Clock converts them to US dollars at the US Treasury's Reporting Rates of Exchange (a quarterly official rate as of 30 September 2026; the page for the World Debt Clock shows the rate and its date).
